title: Recycler - One More Shift Demo - Feedback
author: Weird_Sky_104
selftext:
Hi all :)

Like many of us, I tried to create a lot of different games. For some I spent more time, but in the end I stopped because they just didn't click.

So I thought: What am I actually good at? What is my genre?

It's all kinds of factory stuff.

A factory would be the next project... but there are already a lot of really good factory games. Why should I try to make my own?

Souls-like games are something I like on paper. But man, I am bad at them. And I don't have the energy after work to learn a boss for multiple hours.

And then it clicked.

What if the factory is the boss I have to learn?

I am good at factory games. I like the pressure. But most factory games are pretty cozy. You can take all the time you need. You start your factory and at some point you delete everything and start again with a better layout because you learned something.

And that is Recycler.

A 30-minute shift. No mercy.

You won't survive your first few shifts. But you learn. And your next factory will be better.

I love this idea. But as always, sometimes you don't see the problems yourself.

Try out the demo for free and please give me some feedback! :)

It was built with Godot, VS Code with Claude, and Blender.

And the usual screaming at the monitor and whipping the PC with a belt. /s

Its free to play: [https://drabarus.itch.io/recycler](https://drabarus.itch.io/recycler)
